narrative: Overheads of about €24M are planned by cost center and legal entity: agency overheads and network management, sales and customer service, the IT, data and TMS platform, and HQ functions. Headcount lines are driven from the workforce plan; non-headcount lines use trend or driver methods.

signals.title: Hyperion finance data on Snowflake since September 2024
signals.excerpt: The Oracle/Hyperion finance database was migrated to Snowflake in 2024; budgeting and forecasting still run in Hyperion and Excel. SDP plans on the same governed data.
